# MD091 fixtures

`md091.json` holds the MD091 fixture object with `admission_cases`, `authority`, `base`, `cases`, `composition`, `default_enabled`, `fix`, `issue`, `literal_case_count`, `message`, `not_execution_counts`, `planned_case_flavor_repetitions`, `profiles`, `registry`, `rule_specific_options`, `settings`, `unavailable_reason`.

`md091_opaque.json` holds the MD091 fixture object with `authority`, `cases`, `issue`, `kind`, `literal_case_count`, `message`, `not_execution_counts`, `original_oracle_sha256`, `planned_case_flavor_repetitions`, `profiles`, `qa_report_sha256`.

Expected values are fixed expectations; never regenerate them from production output.
